summary:
Read-only inventory of the DOM/CSS contract in the five JS files (app.js, reader.js, reader-navigation.js, library.js, experience.js), checked against index.html, the current CSS, and the other scripts that share globals. No files were edited.

MUST-KEEP rules for the new CSS (each one breaks the site if missed):
(1) Add a global `[hidden]{display:none!important}`. JS hides `.cards-section`, #readerSectionNav, #meaningToggle, #meaningToggleRow, `.rs-nav` and #readerLinkFallback with the hidden attribute. Any rule that sets `display` on those elements would override it (today this lives in design-system.css:23).
(2) `#homePage[data-view=X] > [data-panel]:not([data-panel=X]){display:none}` for home/library/saved/practice (today design-system.css:213-216). Without it, every home panel shows at once.
(3) The pages and overlays are hidden by default and shown only with `.active`: .reader-page, .track-page, .japamala-page, .search-overlay (also used by #accountOverlay), .feedback-overlay, .day-sheet-overlay.
(4) `.back-btn` is display:none by default. JS only writes inline display 'block'/'none'. `.scroll-top-btn` is hidden until `.visible`. `.origin-block` is hidden until `.visible`. `.reminder-banner` is hidden until `.show`.
(5) `.slokam-meaning` is hidden unless `body.show-meanings`. It must use `font-size: var(--reader-font-size)`, because re-rendering drops its inline size.
(6) `white-space: pre-line` on `.slokam-text` and `.sc-msg`. Verse text and dialog messages use \n line breaks.
(7) `.sc-overlay` is visible (display:flex) as soon as it is appended. `.show` fades it in. Its exit transition must be 180ms or less, because the node is removed after 180ms.
(8) #homePage gets inline `display:flex` from goHome() (app.js:96). The home layout must be a flex column. A grid layout would be overridden after the first navigation.
(9) Keep `scroll-margin-top` on `.slokam-block` so the sticky header does not cover a verse after jumpToVerse. Add a `:focus-visible` treatment, because verse blocks and #homePage receive programmatic focus.

HTML hooks that must survive the index.html restructure:
- #particles must exist. createParticles() has no null check. If it is missing, app.js throws at load and initMeaningsToggle, initVoice, showDueReminders and initHomePradakshina never run.
- #micBtn and #reminderBanner are also used at load time with no null check.
- `.primary-link` and `.skip-link` are queried with no null check (experience.js:47, 62). If `.primary-link` is missing, the rest of the handler dies: no data-view is set, so everything is visible.
- `.welcome-section` and `.home-primary-actions` are required (reader-navigation.js:166-168, 308, 356). `.practice-details` must exist, or `home.append(actions, null)` inserts a literal "null" text node.
- Cards must stay `<a class="card" data-stotram="key">` inside `.cards-section[data-cat]`, with an `h2.section-title`. The library.js selector is tag-qualified (`a.card[data-stotram]`).
- The font buttons must keep the exact attribute strings `onclick="changeFontSize(-2)"` and `onclick="changeFontSize(2)"`. The min/max disabling matches on that literal text.
- #meaningToggle must keep a literal `onclick` attribute and a child `<label>`.
- `.rs-nav` buttons must sit inside `.reader-search`.
- #verseJump stays a `<select>`, #sourceDetails a `<details>`, #readerLinkFallback an `<input>`, #fbType a `<select>`, #restoreFile a file input.

Class names that JS overwrites (static classes added there are wiped): #readerTitleSection becomes 'reader-title-section <theme>-theme' and #sourceStatusBadge becomes 'source-status-badge <state>'.

Containers whose contents JS wipes (put no static markup inside them): #slokamContainer, #searchResults, #readerDeityBg, #originBlock, #reminderBanner, #readerSectionNav, #sourceContent, #verseJump, #favoritesSection, #recentReadingSection, .category-filters.

Final order of #homePage children after load, with the panel each gets:
welcome-section[home] → #recentReadingSection[home] → #todaySection (weekday.js)[home] → nav#library.library-navigation[library] → .cards-section×N[library] → #favoritesSection[saved] → .home-primary-actions#practice[practice] → details.practice-details[practice].
Any new direct child of #homePage (for example a 'What's new / updates' block) is tagged data-panel=home automatically, so it shows only on the Home tab. The matcher list is hard-coded in experience.js:12-14.

Existing problems found:
- reader.js:5 and reader-navigation.js:360 look for `.card[onclick]`, but cards are now onclick-free `<a>` elements. As a result, stotramCategory falls back to cfg.__cat or the /108$/ regex, and only #meaningToggle gets the keyboard enhancement.
- Search results (app.js:167) are onclick `<div>`s and the reminder close (app.js:280) is an onclick `<span>`. Neither is keyboard-focusable. Search title and subtitle are inserted unescaped.
- The `<details class="origin-details">` wrapper (index.html:1033) is never hidden when a stotram has no origin, so an empty expander shows. Its summary also repeats the '📜 ఉద్భవం & ప్రాముఖ్యత' label that app.js:69 puts inside.
- library.js:71 reads #todaySection but never uses it.
- Outside these five files: the global function `bumpJapa` is defined twice, in tracking.js:216 `bumpJapa(i,delta)` and japamala.js:306 `bumpJapa()`. The later one wins. So the day-sheet japa −/＋ buttons (tracking.js:170,172) bump the japamala total instead of that day's japa count.

Functions on window called by index.html inline handlers:
- app.js: goHome, openSearch, closeSearch, runSearch, startVoice, pickSearch (generated markup), exportBackup, triggerRestore, handleRestoreFile, openFeedback, closeFeedback, listenInto, submitFeedback.
- reader.js: changeFontSize, onReaderSearchInput, onReaderSearchKey, startReaderVoice, prevSearchMatch, nextSearchMatch, clearReaderSearch, toggleMeanings, resetReading.
- reader-navigation.js: jumpToVerse, resumeReading.
- library.js: toggleFavorite, copyReaderLink.
- Defined elsewhere: openAccount, closeAccountOverlay, openTrack, closeDay, the Home/Stotram date/reset/bump counter functions, shiftMonth, addMokku (tracking.js); openJapamala, setJmMode, resetJapamala, bumpJapa (japamala.js).
- Also used by other scripts: openReader (weekday.js tiles), siteConfirm/siteAlert (tracking.js, japamala.js, cloud.js), gaEvent, flushFeedback (cloud.js), stopReaderPositionTracking (tracking.js, japamala.js).

Custom events and listeners the new code must not break:
- 'stotras-updated' is dispatched by admin.js. reader-navigation.js and library.js listen for it and re-run the filter/favorites/recent/card set-up.
- popstate, hashchange and storage listeners exist in library.js, reader-navigation.js and experience.js.
- The URL contract is `?stotram=key` for the reader plus `#home|#library|#saved|#practice` for views. experience.js:40 rewrites the nav link hrefs to these.

document.querySelector('.primary-link').addEventListener has NO null check (index.html:565). If it is removed or renamed, a TypeError aborts the handler: no popstate/hashchange listeners, no MutationObserver, render() never runs, data-view is never set, and all panels show.

'.skip-link' is REQUIRED (no null check, index.html:24). A click focuses the first of #readerPage, #trackPage or #japamalaPage that has .active, else #homePage, after setting tabIndex=-1.

Cross-file global collision (outside the five files, but it affects inline handlers): function bumpJapa(i,delta) in tracking.js is overwritten by bumpJapa() in japamala.js, which loads later (index.html:1320-1323). The day-sheet japa −/＋ buttons (tracking.js:170,172 onclick="bumpJapa(i,±1)") therefore increment the japamala total instead of that day's japa count.
